message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: headlamp
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: headlamp
  namespace: headlamp
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: headlamp
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["*"]
    resources: ["*"]
    verbs: ["*"]
  - nonResourceURLs: ["*"]
    verbs: ["*"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: headlamp
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: headlamp
    namespace: headlamp
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: headlamp
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: headlamp
  namespace: headlamp
  labels:
    app: headlamp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: headlamp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: headlamp
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: headlamp
      containers:
        - name: headlamp
          image: ghcr.io/headlamp-k8s/headlamp:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 4466
              name: http
          args:
            - "-in-cluster"
            - "-plugins-dir=/headlamp/plugins"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 4466
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 4466
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: headlamp
  namespace: headlamp
  labels:
    app: headlamp
spec:
  selector:
    app: headlamp
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 4466
  type: ClusterIP
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: headlamp
  namespace: headlamp
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
spec:
  rules:
    - host: headlamp.local
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: headlamp
                port:
                  number: 80
```
